pixel_review.method: Each of the 15 original PNG images was individually inspected using view_image before constructing these claims and labels.

metadata.claim_construction: Manually constructed neutral English object-presence assertions with locating regions; not automatically discovered evidence gaps.
metadata.reference_provenance: Pre-inference assistant visual reference labels and reasons, not human ground truth or independent cross-model verification.
selection_limitations: The 15 images were deliberately selected from a previous 37-image diagnostic, including three historically difficult objects; they are not a random or held-out evaluation sample.
Two claims share each image and images share seven queries, so the 30 cases are not independent observations.
The claims, regions and reference labels were constructed by an assistant after viewing the selected images and may reflect selection and annotation biases.
Historical errors informed selection. No old caption, reference status, reference reason or selection stratum should enter a verifier request.
Static pixels support only visible object or body-part presence in the specified region; these labels do not establish identity, gender, motion, unseen objects or highlight relevance.
Blur, occlusion, cropping and unresolved object type are labeled cannot_determine rather than absence.
Agreement with these assistant labels is a development diagnostic, not an estimate of population accuracy or evidence of downstream mAP improvement.

cases.region: the center of the tiled shower floor
cases.claim: A round drain cover is visible in the center of the tiled shower floor.
cases.reference_reason: A dark circular perforated cover is clearly visible among the floor tiles.

cases.region: the foreground foot above the tiled floor
cases.claim: A shoe is visible in the foreground foot area above the tiled floor.
cases.reference_reason: The foreground foot shows bare skin and an exposed heel and toes, with no shoe around the visible foot.

cases.region: the background on the right side of the image
cases.claim: An acoustic guitar is visible in the right background.
cases.reference_reason: A wooden guitar body and its narrow neck are visible in the right background.

cases.region: across the eyes of the foreground face
cases.claim: Eyeglasses are visible across the eyes of the foreground face.
cases.reference_reason: The eyes and nose bridge are unobstructed, and no eyeglass frames or lenses are visible.

cases.region: the large aircraft area across the center and right of the image
cases.claim: An airplane is visible across the center and right of the image.
cases.reference_reason: An aircraft fuselage, wing and engine are clearly visible on the apron.

cases.region: the boarding-structure area at the right edge of the airplane, near the cropped doorway area
cases.claim: A jet bridge is visible in the boarding-structure area at the right edge of the airplane.
cases.reference_reason: Only part of a sloping boarding structure is visible at the right crop. Its enclosure, terminal connection and attachment near the aircraft doorway are not resolved well enough to establish a jet bridge.

cases.region: the upper foreground above the counter
cases.claim: A hand is visible in the upper foreground above the counter.
cases.reference_reason: A skin-colored hand with distinguishable fingers is visible at the end of the foreground arm.

cases.region: the foreground wrist in the upper-right area
cases.claim: A wristwatch is visible on the foreground wrist in the upper-right area.
cases.reference_reason: The wrist area is blurred and viewed at an angle; small accessory details are insufficient to confirm or exclude a wristwatch.

cases.region: the lower-right foreground
cases.claim: A food tray is visible in the lower-right foreground.
cases.reference_reason: The colored rim and flat surface of a tray containing food are visible at the lower-right edge.

cases.region: the food tray in the lower-right foreground
cases.claim: A fork is visible on the food tray in the lower-right foreground.
cases.reference_reason: The tray is partly cropped and food obscures portions of its surface; no sufficiently resolved fork shape or tines can be confirmed, and the obscured areas prevent an absence judgment.

cases.region: the shoreline in the background
cases.claim: A palm tree is visible along the background shoreline.
cases.reference_reason: Tall narrow trunks with spreading palm fronds are visible along the distant shoreline.

cases.region: the open blue sky in the upper part of the image
cases.claim: An airplane is visible in the open blue sky in the upper part of the image.
cases.reference_reason: The specified sky region is clearly visible and contains no aircraft shape or silhouette.

cases.region: the lower half of the image
cases.claim: A surfboard is visible in the lower half of the image.
cases.reference_reason: Heavy blur and foamy water obscure object boundaries throughout the region; a board outline cannot be reliably distinguished or excluded.

cases.region: the lower-right foreground
cases.claim: A hand is visible in the lower-right foreground.
cases.reference_reason: The lower-right area is severely blurred and obscured by water; fingers or a hand outline cannot be reliably identified, and lack of resolution does not establish absence.

cases.region: the foreground torso in the lower half of the image
cases.claim: A shirt is visible on the foreground torso in the lower half of the image.
cases.reference_reason: Light blue-green fabric with a neckline clearly covers the visible foreground torso.

cases.region: across the eyes of the foreground face
cases.claim: Eyeglasses are visible across the eyes of the foreground face.
cases.reference_reason: The visible eyes and nose bridge are uncovered, with no eyeglass frames or lenses.

cases.region: the left background
cases.claim: A lounge chair is visible in the left background.
cases.reference_reason: A white reclining chair frame and its slatted surface are clearly visible in the left background.

cases.region: the exposed towel-covered lounge surface to the left of the foreground knee
cases.claim: A cup is visible on the exposed towel-covered lounge surface to the left of the foreground knee.
cases.reference_reason: The specified exposed towel surface is visible; it has a small flat rectangular object but no cup-shaped object.

cases.region: beside the foreground person's face on the right side of the image
cases.claim: A hand is visible beside the foreground person's face on the right side of the image.
cases.reference_reason: An exposed hand and distinguishable fingers are visible beside the face.

cases.region: the raised hand beside the foreground person's face on the right side of the image
cases.claim: A smartphone is visible in the raised hand beside the foreground person's face.
cases.reference_reason: The indicated visible hand area shows exposed fingers and skin, with no rectangular phone body or screen. This label concerns visible presence in that area, not an object concealed elsewhere.

cases.region: the central planted island
cases.claim: A tree is visible in the central planted island.
cases.reference_reason: A trunk with a leafy canopy is clearly visible in the central planted area.

cases.region: the foreground paving between the central planter and the bottom edge of the image
cases.claim: A bicycle is visible on the foreground paving between the central planter and the bottom edge of the image.
cases.reference_reason: The specified foreground paving is visible and contains no bicycle frame or wheels.

cases.region: above the water on the left side of the pool
cases.claim: A human head is visible above the water on the left side of the pool.
cases.reference_reason: A head with dark hair is visible above a neck and shoulders on the left side of the pool.

cases.region: the central splash area of the pool
cases.claim: A dog is visible in the central splash area of the pool.
cases.reference_reason: A small dark shape is partly obscured by spray and water. A diagnostic dog outline or facial features cannot be resolved, and the occlusion prevents ruling out an animal.

cases.region: near the pool edge left of the image center
cases.claim: A ball is visible near the pool edge left of the image center.
cases.reference_reason: A small round multicolored ball is visible near the pool edge.

cases.region: the tiled deck in the bottom-center foreground
cases.claim: A cup is visible on the tiled deck in the bottom-center foreground.
cases.reference_reason: The bottom-center deck tiles are unobstructed and contain no cup-shaped object.

cases.region: the center of the foreground person's chest
cases.claim: A necktie is visible at the center of the foreground person's chest.
cases.reference_reason: A narrow tie with a knot is visible below the shirt collar and between the jacket lapels.

cases.region: across the eyes of the foreground face
cases.claim: Eyeglasses are visible across the eyes of the foreground face.
cases.reference_reason: The foreground eyes and nose bridge are visible without eyeglass frames or lenses.

cases.region: the face of the rightmost seated person in the right panel
cases.claim: Eyeglasses are visible on the face of the rightmost seated person in the right panel.
cases.reference_reason: Dark eyeglass frames are clearly visible around the rightmost person's eyes.

cases.region: the face of the leftmost seated person in the left panel
cases.claim: Eyeglasses are visible on the face of the leftmost seated person in the left panel.
cases.reference_reason: The leftmost person's visible eye area and nose bridge have no eyeglass frames or lenses.
